entry.title: When the Jacobian Is Dense but the Program Is Not
entry.summary: How automatic differentiation computes large, sparse Jacobians at a fraction of the cost of dense ones, starting from the factored Jacobian of any program.

entry.title: Which Way Is Down? First-Order Optimizers as a Choice of Norm
entry.summary: First-order optimizers as steepest descent under a choice of norm, and how that choice determines the step.

entry.title: The Polar Express Algorithm
entry.summary: Approximating the sign function by compositions of polynomials, which gives the polar factor of a matrix with only matrix products, as in the Muon optimizer.

entry.title: Batched Backpropagation as a Linear Solve
entry.summary: Backpropagation as a linear solve, extended to batches of inputs with sparse matrices whose entries are linear maps.

entry.title: Backpropagation as a Linear Solve
entry.summary: Backpropagation derived directly from the chain rule, as the solution of a sparse, lower-triangular linear system.

entry.title: Dual Numbers for Automatic Differentiation
entry.summary: Dual numbers for forward-mode automatic differentiation, introduced as a number type that tracks the value of a function and its derivative at the same time.

entry.title: The Boundary Element Method
entry.summary: The boundary element method rewrites the Helmholtz equation as an integral equation on the boundary, so that only the boundary has to be divided into elements.

entry.title: The Finite Element Method
entry.summary: An introduction to the finite element method: how a partial differential equation, here the Helmholtz equation, becomes a linear system of equations.

entry.title: Conic Optimization
entry.summary: The central ideas behind efficient interior-point methods for conic programs, with the implementation details that the papers on Clarabel and CVXOPT leave out.

entry.title: Backpropagation is the Adjoint Method
entry.summary: Backpropagation is a special case of the adjoint method, one where the lower-triangular structure of the problem makes the solve cheap.

entry.title: Associative Scan
entry.summary: How the associative scan parallelizes the state computation of state-space models such as S5 and Mamba on the GPU.

entry.title: Structured Masked Attention (SMA)
entry.summary: Masked attention with a structured mask, and how low-rank structure turns it into a semiseparable matrix that can be multiplied with in linear time.
